title: VLOOKUP_CONNECTION
description: Performs a dynamic lookup on a Salesforce object through a connection and returns the specified field value (including relational fields up to 5 levels), from the first matching record.
syntax: VLOOKUP_CONNECTION(connection_name, object_name, return_field_name, ...[matching_field_name, matching_field_value], additional_clause_optional) -> Object

parameters.name: connection_name
parameters.description: The name of the connection to use.

parameters.name: object_name
parameters.description: The name of the object to look up.

parameters.name: return_field_name
parameters.description: The name of the field whose value will be returned.

parameters.name: …matching_field_name
parameters.description: The name of the field used to match records.

parameters.name: …matching_field_value
parameters.description: The field value used as matching criteria.

parameters.name: additional_clause_optional
parameters.description: Additional query conditions for more precise filtering.

examples:
VLOOKUP_CONNECTION("SalesforceProd",
                   "Opportunity",
                   "Amount", 
                   "Account.SourceSystemID__c",
                    SourceSystemID__c)
-- Returns the Amount from the first Opportunity in the "SalesforceProd" org where Account.SourceSystemID__c matches the current record's SourceSystemID__c.

VLOOKUP_CONNECTION("SalesforceProd", 
                   "Opportunity", 
                   "Amount", 
                   "AccountId", Id, 
                   "OwnerId", $User.Id, 
                   "FiscalYear = 2024")
-- Returns the Amount from the first Opportunity in the "SalesforceProd" org where:
-- AccountId matches the current record's Id,
-- OwnerId matches the current user's Id,
-- and FiscalYear = 2024.

VLOOKUP_CONNECTION("$Source",
                   "Opportunity",
                   "Amount", 
                   "AccountId",
                    Id, 
                   "IsClosed = FALSE ORDER BY CloseDate ASC")
-- Returns the Amount of the open Opportunity with the earliest Close Date in the Source Connection related to the current Executable, whose AccountId matches the current Account's Id.
